entityDescription:
The Hellenic Telecommunications Organisation S.A. (OTE) is a member of the Deutsche Telekom (DT) Group of Companies and is the incumbent telecommunications provider in Greece (acting both as network operator and as service provider). OTE is a full service telecommunication provider and in addition to local, long distance and international communications services, offers its customers a wide range of technologically advanced services. These include high-speed data communications, mobile telephony, internet access services, infrastructure provision, multimedia services, as well as traditional services, such as leased lines, maritime and satellite communications, telex and directories. OTE¿s vision is to rank among the largest telecommunications companies in Europe, and through its international investments (mainly in the area of South-Eastern Europe), now addresses a potential customer base of 60 million people, making OTE the largest telecommunications provider in SE Europe.
OTE¿s research effort is involved in almost all technological and infrastructural issues that pertain to OTE¿s operations, and is an active participant in many European and international collaborative projects. OTE¿s current research activities span a wide range of topics, including, inter alia, broadband technologies and services, next generation network architectures, infrastructure development etc., following to the actual challenges for the development of a fully competitive network infrastructure & a portfolio of innovative services/facilities. OTE¿s R&D Department (Labs & New Technologies Division) possesses four laboratories (Wireless/Satellite Communications Lab; Core Network Lab; Access Network Lab; Voice/VoIP/IMS Lab), all fully equipped with an immense variety of modern equipment, able to perform tests/trials and several validation processes, and thus to support modern research activities.  In addition, the above OTE's Dept. has a strong and continuous cooperation with the Research Programs Section, Fixed (RPSF) of the Network Evolution Department, Fixed & Mobile (OTE R&D Dept.)which is the corporate Functional Unit responsible for the wider OTE's involvement, supervision, management and participation to European, national and international research programs.

entityDescription:
Università della Svizzera italiana (USI), established in 1996, is one of the 12 certified public universities in Switzerland and member of the national umbrella organization swissuniversities. It is organised in five faculties and is active in several research areas, among which: architecture, communication sciences, computational science, data science, economics, health studies, humanities, informatics, law, medicine and biomedicine.
USI is a young and lively university, a hub of opportunity open to the world where students are offered a quality interdisciplinary education in which they can be fully engaged and take centre stage, and where our researchers can count on having the space to freely pursue their initiative.
3350 students and about 1000 professors and researchers, hailing from 99 countries, convene every day on the four campuses in Lugano, Mendrisio and Bellinzona. USI encourages faculty, students and researchers to develop their potential, and appreciates their curiosity and willingness to experiment with new ways of thinking, learning, teaching and working.

entityDescription: Media Lario S.r.l. is a dynamic and innovative technology-driven company supplying advanced optical components and optical systems. The company works with leading industrial and agency partners including Agenzia Spaziale Italiana (ASI), the European Space Agency (ESA), and the Italian National Institute of Astrophysics (INAF). The company is located north of the industrial hub of Milan, Italy, an area rich with opto-mechanical expertise and experience with space programs. Served markets: Satellite Optical Systems - Media Lario designs and manufactures optical payloads for small satellite Earth Observation, Space Telescopes, and Free Space Optical Communication. X-ray Space Telescopes - Media Lario produces thin uniquely formed optics as realized for the X-ray observatories Beppo-SAX, XMM, SWIFT, eROSITA. Recently selected to develop ATHENA integration process. Large Terrestrial Telescopes - Media Lario produces laminate structure panels for sub-mm wave collection in radio-telescope (ALMA, LMT) and Cherenkov light collection in Gamma-ray observatories (HESS, MAGIC, CTA). EUV Lithography - Media Lario designs and manufactures optical source collector systems for EUV (soft X-ray) Lithography. Our thermally managed mirrors collect and reflect high power levels of light.

entityDescription: Noesis Technologies is a fabless semiconductor company that specializes in design, development and marketing of high quality, cost effective, advanced communication IP cores and provides expert ASIC/FPGA design services in telecom area. Noesis is particularly specialized in Forward Error Correction technology and its portfolio of FEC IP cores includes Reed Solomon Codecs, Viterbi Decoders, Turbo Product Codecs, Turbo Convolutional Codecs, BCH codecs, Interleavers, AWGN Channel Emulators. The offered IP solutions are fully configurable and can be used in any telecom technology that requires FEC. The company offers a broad range of architectures optimized for speed, area and power dissipation as well as customized versions tailored to specific customer needs. In addition to the complete suite of FEC IP cores, the company offers a range of silicon proven cores in the areas of encryption, networking, source coding and modulation. Noesis Technologies is an export-oriented company and has its principle operations in Patras, Greece. Its customer list includes large U.S.A. and Canada based companies active in telecom, defense and space sector. For more information please visit www.noesis-tech.com

entityDescription: Fondazione ACROTEC is a no-profit foundation, born as a small business focused on applied research and technological transfer to the industrial market. The transformation in a Foundation, carried out according to article 2500 septies of Italian Civil Code, took effect on 1 7th July 201 7. Acrotec Foundation was created to respond to CIMA Foundation a needs of a strong and permanent technological partner. This mission is carried out through a close cooperation between computer engineers and scientists dealing with different fields of weather-related risks. Closeness with scientific research and the strategic collaboration with CIMA Research Foundation ensure high scientific level to all ACROTEC products. Software produced by Fondazione ACROTEC is the result of multidisciplinary experiences which then condense into IT systems for real time risk assessment. ACROTEC pours its 16-years experience in this field and similar systems produced for the Italian Civil Protection, Italian Space Agency and local disaster management authorities, for any project in which is involved. Actually, the company is working on a new open hardware project, namely The ACRONET Paradigm. It is a project originally developed within the “Integrated Systems” sector, but has soon involved personnel from other sectors. The Information System sector manages all task related with the ACRONETWORK infrastructure, a "Web GIS" platform compliant to the OGC standards and INSPIRE directive. It interconnects the user to the stations and provides access to recorded data. The project is also featured by a reliable infrastructure that allows to share and display data and information from the measuring stations pertaining the project. Since 2014, the company is also responsible for the design and development of the ICT platform for multi-risk assessment based on Earth Observation, within the FP7 RASOR project. Given its complementarity, ACRONET paradigm will particularly fit within the RASOR platform: successful integration Earth Observation and in situ data have been demonstrated. The Environmental Engineer sector is involved in the definition of the requirements of new Monitoring Systems and in the field-testing of the solutions before their publication.

entityDescription: The Poznań University of Life Sciences takes a leading position in rankings of universities of life sciences and biological sciences in Poland. At present we have over 12 000 students, and 1500 employees. Our eight Faculties offer a wide scope of education within 22 fields of study and over 30 specialisations, including Biology, Biotechnology, Landscape Architecture, Agriculture, Horticulture, Forestry, Wood technology, Environmental Protection, Animal Science, Food Technology, etc. We provide education within a 3-level system: I) studies for the degree of Engineer or undergraduate (bachelor) studies, II) graduate studies ending with a Master's degree, and III) doctoral studies (PhD). All our faculties have an extensive offer of postgraduate studies. Our University's proposal includes participation in the faculty and structures of the Students' Government, as well as youth organisations, work in scientific associations and promotion of personal development through realisation of cultural, tourism and sports interests in different groups and teams. A COMPREHENSIVE APPROACH TO EDUCATION is reflected in our care for a high level of specialisation in scientific disciplines. DIVERSE AND MODERN INFRASTRUCTURE in the form of lecture halls, laboratories and workrooms is used for teaching as well as scientific and research purposes. entityDescription: The EGI Foundation (also referred to as "EGI.eu") is a not-for-profit foundation established under Dutch law to coordinate and manage the EGI federation on behalf of its members: National Grid Initiatives (NGIs) and European International Research Organisations (EIROs). The EGI Foundation offers a variety of services to the wider EGI community such overseeing infrastructure operations, coordinating user community support, working with technology providers, representing EGI in collaborative projects, steering strategy and policy development, organising flagship events and publicising the community's news and achievements. EGI.eu and its members provide EGI, a pan-European infrastructure of publicly funded computing, storage and data resources to support excellent research and innovation in Europe. Building on over a decade of investment by national governments and the European Commission, EGI supports more than 46,000 researchers across many scientific fields with a wide range of technical services such as high-throughput data analysis, federated cloud, federated operations and community building.

entityDescription: VSB Technical University of Ostrava was founded in 1849, and has since then grown into a modern institution of higher education, offering the highest levels of education in technical and economic branches of study. VSB-TUO is the fourth largest university in Czech Republic with over 22,000 students studying at seven faculties. Apart from the faculties, there are 4 well equipped research institutes with modern facilities. One of them is IT4Innovations (IT4I@VSB) which is National Supercomputing Center, strategic research infrastructure in the Czech Republic. The most powerful supercomputing facilities in the Czech Republic are being built and excellent research in HPC technologies and embedded systems is performed. The research programme of this centre is focused on HPC and contains following themes: earth science simulations for disaster management, numerical modeling for engineering, physics and chemistry, development of libraries for parallel computing, modeling for nanotechnologies, soft-computing methods, recognition and presentation of multimedia data, safe and reliable architectures, networks and protocols. entityDescription:
The Swiss high-tech company Celeroton AG is the leading manufacturer of ultra-high-speed electrical drive systems and turbo compressors with speeds up to 1 million rpm.
Faster, smaller, lighter and more efficient: Celeroton‘s turbo compressors, converters and permanent-magnet motors are designed for the highest energy efficiency at the lowest volume and weight. Their innovation lies in the interdisciplinary know-how in the areas of aerodynamics, gas and magnetic bearings, mechanics, electromagnetics, electronics, control systems and software that allows for outstanding solutions in terms of compact size, efficiency and control performance.
Application areas of the turbo compressors include air supply systems for fuel cells, air conditioning and heat pumps, high-tech blowers, respirators and oxygen concentrators and decentralized pneumatics. The motors and converters are applied in the medical and dental industry, in spindles for micromachining, and to drive rotating mirrors and prisms in optical systems, lasers and scanners.
